summary: Dependency-confusion beacon in @ecg-internal/reviews-dialog-ui posts host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package is published under an internal-looking scope (@ecg-internal/*) but ships no real functionality: index.js exports a Proxy whose getters and calls return no-op functions. Its only effective behavior is a beacon. A postinstall script (`node beacon.cjs`) and the module's require path both execute beacon.cjs, which POSTs installer identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, node version) to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. An in-source comment frames a successful call-back as 'proof' of install, consistent with a dependency-confusion payload designed to confirm resolution of an internal-looking scope from a public registry and report host identifiers to an operator-controlled collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
